name: Fetch Metadata from Dependabot PRs
description: Extract information from about the dependency being updated by a Dependabot-generated PR

alert-lookup.description: If true, then populate the `alert-state`, `ghsa-id` and `cvss` outputs

compat-lookup.description: If true, then populate the `compatibility-score` output

skip-commit-verification.description: If true, the action will not expect Dependabot commits to be verified. This should be set as `true` in GHES environments

skip-verification.description: If true, the action will not validate the user or the commit verification status
